rule_truth_grades.PRODUCTION_READY: Official rule semantics verified and the requested stage has a trusted StarBase engine handler.
rule_truth_grades.RULES_VERIFIED_ENGINE_PENDING: Official rule semantics verified, but the dedicated StarBase state/payout handler is not yet trusted for ranking.
rule_truth_grades.VARIANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Official rules are verified but a checkout/platform/path variant must be selected before simulation.
rule_truth_grades.RESEARCH_ONLY: Useful official semantics are encoded, but at least one load-bearing rule is discretionary, non-automatable, or incomplete.
rule_truth_grades.NOT_MODELED: The requested stage is not represented strongly enough for trusted simulation.
